### ![Android logo](data:image/png;base64,) Android Exception Details

Shows all details about a single exception. Open it from the "Android Application Overview" dashboard by clicking a group ID in the crashes table of its Crashes section. The group ID filter at the top narrows every panel to that exception.

* Click a session ID in "Top affected sessions" to open the Application Overview filtered by that session.
* "Top exception messages" lists the message variants behind this stack trace, useful when the message carries variables.
* The "Stack trace" section shows the full trace of the most recent occurrence.
* Each panel has a description that explains in detail what it shows. Hover over its info icon (a circled "i" letter) to read it.
